findings.title: A finished slice's cleanup still writes into a story worktree that is mid-rebase
findings.detail:
When the story unit is rebasing but a slice unit is not, slice.done.cleanup (mark_done) still runs: act's markDone (packages/cli/src/runtime/act/lifecycle.ts:102-118) integrates the slice into storyCwd and patches the slice file's status there, i.e. into the rewound tree / detached HEAD. Not runs/, and re-emitted after an abort since the frontmatter is not integrated, so it does not reproduce gh-79's corruption; but it is the same class of write the Wanted section rules out ('norn does not act on' a rebasing worktree).
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Follow-up: hold slice.done.cleanup (and any action whose effect lands in the story worktree) while the story unit is rebasing.
